WPSS No.37 of 2017
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(Through Video Conferencing)
Mr. K.K. Harbola, Advocate holding brief of 
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. P.C. Bisht, Addl. C.S.C. for the State of 
Uttarakhand/respondent nos.1, 2 & 6. 
Mrs. Monika Pant, Advocate for respondent 
nos.3 to 5.
Today, the matter is listed on an Urgency 
Appl. No.12679 of 2022 preferred by respondent 
nos.3 to 5 on the ground that the writ petition is 
pending consideration since 2017, where there 
operates an interim order of 09.01.2017 against 
them. 
Pleadings have been exchanged. 
The writ petition is ripe up for hearing.
Considering the backdrop of the pleadings 
raised in the urgency application, the same would 
stand allowed. 
The writ petition is directed to be listed in the 
week commencing 14.03.2022. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 17.02.2022
